title: Complete the operations-base utility foothold through normal construction
objective: Use the existing normal permit, finance, mobilization, project, completed-asset, and root-derived registration paths to construct and connect the power, sewage, and water corridors; preserve communications; and make the unbuilt operations-base preview report all four utilities connected with exact capacity and bottleneck evidence.
rationale: The communications corridor already proves the complete causal seam. Extending the same public-action and shared-rule boundary to the three remaining prerequisite utilities is the smallest dependency-valid vertical slice before operations-base construction and the later skiing spine.
exclusions: Do not commit or construct the operations-base facility.
Do not add a new utility kind, global utility flag, instant-build command, privileged bot path, or test-only entitlement.
Do not add lifts, trails, guests, operating days, snow, avalanche, staffing, vehicles, maintenance, traffic, benchmark scenarios, readiness stages, calibration, or acceptance verdicts.
Do not add decorative skiing content before the operations prerequisite exists.

acceptanceCriteria.description: The accepted communications asset, root-derived registration, service connection, finance, construction, save/replay, and inspection facts remain exact.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: The prior communications verifier and the new combined verifier reproduce the accepted checkpoints and hashes before adding the other corridors.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Power, sewage, and water each use normal disclosed finance, land/permit context, mobilization, material/crew, and project-commit player actions with no privileged mutation.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: A fresh-process proof records every public action, economic posting, authorization, resource reservation/consumption, crew assignment/release, schedule, and completion checkpoint.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Each physical-network registration is derived only from its matching newly completed construction asset, and service changes only after canonical registration processing.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: One-tick boundary checkpoints prove no early segment, exact completed-asset evidence, pending registration, and subsequent connection for each utility.

acceptanceCriteria.description: The canonical Standard read model reports communications, power, sewage, and water connected with exact source, capacity, demand, spare-capacity, and bottleneck evidence while the operations base remains unbuilt.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: Node and production Worker inspections match exactly and the rendered operations-base preview shows zero disconnected utilities without a facility action.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Direct/chunked execution, human/bot/replay origins, fresh reconstruction, save/re-encode, save/load continuation, replay/re-encode, and corruption rejection converge for all four corridors.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: The focused verifier owns two byte-identical fresh-process proofs, canonical save/replay checksums, checkpoint equality, and atomic rejection diagnostics.

acceptanceCriteria.description: The public Node host and dedicated production Worker execute the same actions and return the same complete projections, with inspectable Chromium evidence and no material diagnostics.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: The focused verifier retains Worker parity, Playwright, browser diagnostics, and command-owned receipt artifacts.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Focused compatibility, complete serial regression, static/build checks, exact clean no-argument readiness verification, and independent review pass without implementing the facility or reducing scope.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: All declared receipts/artifacts validate on the exact clean commit; readiness remains honestly governed by the unchanged fifteen-stage aggregate.

terminalConditions: All three additional corridors are constructed and connected through normal actions while communications remains exact.
The operations-base preview shows all four utilities connected and the facility remains unbuilt.
Every focused, compatibility, complete, exact, and independent-review gate passes on one clean commit.
